cases.request: Rewrite this LinkedIn post so it sounds less AI-generated while keeping my product judgment and facts.
cases.audience: AI product managers and engineering leaders on LinkedIn
cases.reader_outcome: Understand why the measured result remained marginal.
cases.draft:
What most people miss is that an LLM judge can look accurate and still be unsafe to trust.

The best part: I measured 76.5% agreement with human graders. This robust result changes everything.

I could lower the threshold and call it a pass. I marked it MARGINAL instead.
cases.expected_output:
My LLM judge agreed with human graders 76.5% of the time. I still marked it MARGINAL.

I could lower the threshold and call it a pass. I chose not to.

cases.request: Sharpen this product note without changing its claims.
cases.reader_outcome: Evaluate the complete AI product workflow.
cases.draft:
An AI feature is a product system, not just a model. A model demo can pass while the full product workflow still fails.

Our evaluation must cover inputs, tool calls, failure handling, latency, cost, and whether the user reaches the intended outcome.
cases.expected_output:
An AI feature can pass a model demo and still fail across the product workflow.

Evaluate the inputs, tool calls, failure handling, latency, cost, and whether the user reaches the intended outcome.
